hero.title: About the Faculty of Computing and Data Science
hero.subtitle: A modern academic institution combining excellent education, scientific research, and entrepreneurship to prepare the leaders of digital transformation.

overview.label: About Us
overview.title: Who We Are
overview.paragraph1: The Faculty of Computing and Data Science at Alexandria University is one of the leading faculties specialized in computing, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. It was founded to meet the growing demand for qualified talent in the digital job market.
overview.paragraph2: We offer accredited and up-to-date academic programs, labs equipped with the latest technologies, and a faculty with strong academic and industry experience, aiming to graduate professionals able to compete locally and globally.
overview.imageAlt: Faculty of Computing and Data Science building

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: The college seeks to provide distinguished education and scientific research in the fields of computers and data sciences, by offering modern academic programs in accordance with national and international standards for the quality of education using advanced learning patterns and methods to create highly competitive cadres of specialists in the fields of computers and data science.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Preparing specialized and distinguished cadres and qualifying competencies to compete professionally in the fields of computers and data sciences by providing distinguished educational programs in accordance with national and international standards for the quality of education in a way that contributes to building a knowledge economy and solving the technical and informational problems of society. and preparing graduates who are able to enable the various sectors of the labor market to invest modern technology and information technologies to serve the community.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: A constant pursuit of the highest quality standards in education and research.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: Encouraging creative ideas and adopting the latest technologies.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.description: Commitment to ethical values and transparency in all our work.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: Building effective partnerships with academic and industry institutions.
